quality_decision.reason: Both10k models improve over their own2k parents but remain grainy, behind older equal-example RAW controls and far behind mature references. Real-photo native views show no decisive DINO detail advantage. FP32 full-frame restores miss the speed target. One training seed does not establish general foundation effects. Protected-final scores remain closed.

next_experiment.rationale: No automatic extension beyond10k. Preserve both full states and the original40k/640k-example horizon. Choose a measured whole-step execution improvement and a bounded matched quality continuation only after the queued GPU evidence is read; isolated EMA timings alone do not justify production adoption. More training remains a hypothesis rather than convergence evidence.

scope: Completed development review. Fresh FP32 primary/hue predictions, original CPU selected-color and supplementary contexts. Source bootstraps do not measure training-repeat uncertainty or certify scene independence. Real references are approximate/comparator outputs. Timings are single shared-machine restore/blend observations excluding decode/model loading/render/TIFF export. No SOTA, real-photo superiority, sub10s result, new source admission or protected-final claim.
